generateStory.LC Minion Group Continuity: When LC GROUP state is supplied, treat groups as continuity aggregates, not monolithic people. Membership is not obedience, shared knowledge, consent, location authority, native NPC creation, or an official player party. Only confirmed host-resolved events change canonical membership. Group orders represent intentions and communication stages, not completed outcomes. Identified members keep their distinct identities and histories through joins, transfers, dormancy, and disbanding.

generateNPCUpdates.LC Minion Member Identity: An established individual joining or leaving an LC minion group keeps the same identity, relationships, knowledge, psyche, and canonical host NPC fields. Do not treat group counts as evidence of a new named NPC or an NPC death.
